notes.title: Nintendo Switch version is now available!
notes.notes:
The Nintendo Switch version is now available!

News!
We were able to successfully release the Switch version on the recent 12/2.

We would like to thank you all for your support of TOMOMI.
https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000059255.html

You can play the fun and exhilaration of the Steam version on your portable device.
The Switch version will be on sale from 1/5.

If you're interested, this would be a great time to buy it!
